scope: Interpret the four screenshots supplied by the user as visual direction. No source image uploaded or copied. Exact plans and dimensions cannot be determined from exterior images.
designPolicy: Warm European residential architecture, practical 100–200 m² approximate target, mid-market design goal subject to costing. Keep one-storey and other approved categories. Do not remove V69 or prior laboratory work.

families.title: Немецкий кирпичный дом с поперечным фронтоном
families.reference: Screenshot 3 main house; screenshot 2 top left
features: prominent cross gable above entrance with paired upper windows
warm variegated brick, dark green or charcoal joinery
families.budget: Limit to one functional cross gable; no balcony by default.

families.title: Светлый европейский дом с двумя люкарнами
features: two compact pitched dormers on garden roof slope
families.budget: Balcony and bay optional; check daylight and usable attic area.

families.title: Классический коттедж с эркером
features: dominant street gable, secondary pitched roof volume
faceted bay on ground level, supported balcony above
beige brick, white eaves and window surrounds
families.budget: Keep roof intersections few; bay, balcony and carport individually priced.

families.title: Голландский семейный коттедж
features: dark tiled roof and muted brick
rhythm of white framed windows, centered entry
families.budget: Two dormer alternative; simplify roof geometry.

families.title: Современный европейский дом с садовым эркером
features: lower glazed garden volume with flat canopy
warm render and contrasting stone accents
warm interior lighting and sheltered patio
families.budget: Avoid full-height glazing on every elevation; resolve roof drainage.

families.title: Альпийский семейный коттедж
features: recessed covered balcony supported within main volume
families.budget: Use modest overhangs and optional balcony; verify snow and wind design.

families.title: Одноэтажный европейский кирпичный дом
families.reference: Screenshot 2 lower right; adapt style to one-storey
features: warm brick facade with shallow entrance projection
families.budget: Simple envelope; no unnecessary upper windows or false habitable level.

qualityGate: Each family needs original geometry and real window/door openings
Model roof tiles, dormers and actual roof intersections; no decorative geometry covering roof without an opening if described as habitable
Balconies supported, drainage considered, carports optional
Interior layouts coordinate with dormers, windows and stair; area derived from geometry
Professional architectural render of same mesh, realistic vegetation, materials, reflections, eye-level framing
No claim of mid-market cost until checked in regional estimate
Reference imagery not reused publicly without rights; screenshot labels are not verified source identity or project area
